draft_source_policy: Temporary OCR drafts may aid correction but must not be committed before review.
validation_requirements: Corrected text must be checked against page images before commit.
Each corrected segment must keep page or page-range locator metadata.
Uncorrected OCR drafts and temporary crops must remain outside the repository.
Learning notes and candidate intake wait until corrected prepared text exists.
blocker_reason: Correction packet is ready, but human-corrected prepared text has not been produced yet.
rationale: The verified vertical OCR route can support correction, but only reviewed text can become prepared material.
guardrails: Do not commit uncorrected OCR drafts or temporary page crops.
Do not create learning notes, 013 candidates, or 012 units from the correction packet.
Create the planned prepared-text artifact only after human correction.
Keep the original PDF unmoved and unchanged.
